entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A massive stone slab created by Azor with his spark to prevent planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan, later used by Nicol Bolas to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: An ancient sphinx planeswalker who created the Immortal Sun with his spark, trapping himself on Ixalan.

entities.name: Spirit Dragon
entities.description: The being with whom Azor planned to trap Nicol Bolas on Ixalan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who sent Vraska to retrieve the Immortal Sun and used it to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A hidden ancient metropolis in Ixalan's jungles built by the Sun Empire, housing the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane on which the Immortal Sun was kept.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The continent where the Immortal Sun was first kept in a hidden monastery.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampiric faction that came to Ixalan to retrieve the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: Leader of hostile forces who attacked the monastery holding the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The Ixalani empire that built Orazca and later left it at Azor's behest.

entities.name: Metzali, Tower of Triumph
entities.description: The tower whose highest chamber held the embedded Immortal Sun.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk tasked by Azor to defend the Golden City and the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirates who sought the Immortal Sun to return to Torrezon and drive out the Legion of Dusk.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A merfolk who defied his people to seek the Immortal Sun to kill outsiders.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A warrior-poet planeswalker tasked by the Emperor to reclaim the Golden City for the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A merfolk and Kumena's former teacher, who allies with Huatli to stop Kumena.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the race for Orazca.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker tasked by Bolas to retrieve the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who lost his memory after fighting Bolas on Amonkhet and travels with Vraska.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: A vampire of the Legion of Dusk who helps defeat Kumena.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire who helps Vona defeat Kumena.

entities.name: Malcom
entities.description: A Siren pirate who draws Tishana and Huatli out of their fight.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate who slashes at Vona's face and eyes.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Bolas's henchman who spirits the Immortal Sun off Ixalan with the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Bolas plotted to invade with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica, in which the Immortal Sun trapped planeswalkers.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: The device that lured planeswalkers to Ravnica.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who shuts off the Immortal Sun using Azor's nine words.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker tasked with shutting off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker tasked with shutting off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A character tasked with shutting off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A shapeshifter who aids the effort to shut off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The place on Ravnica where the Immortal Sun was shut off, later damaged in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The Azorius figure defeated at New Prahv.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who brings up Liliana as an antagonist the Sun could help defeat.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker raised as an antagonist the Sun could help defeat.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The artifact Vraska directed to attack the Azorius guild hall and jail.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which New Prahv was severely damaged.

events.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his spark, trapping himself and preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
events.quote: Azor created the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his planeswalker's spark

events.summary: Hostile forces under Pedron the Wicked attack the monastery in Torrezon; Azor takes the Sun across the sea to Ixalan.
events.quote: The Sun was taken by Azor, and he brought it across the sea to the continent of Ixalan

events.summary: The Sun Empire builds Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misuses it, and Azor makes the Empire leave the hidden city.
events.quote: As a consequence, Azor caused the Empire to leave the city.

events.summary: Azor tasks the merfolk River Heralds with defending the Golden City and the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: The merfolk River Heralds were then tasked by Azor to defend the Golden City

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

events.summary: Kumena reaches the Sanctum of the Sun but is bested by Vona and Mavren Fein and thrown out of the tower, then saved by Tishana.
events.quote: he was saved in time by his former teacher, Tishana

events.summary: A brawl erupts in the chamber and everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who spirits the Immortal Sun off the plane, revealing Bolas's plan to invade Ravnica.
events.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to spirit the Immortal Sun off the plane.

events.summary: Bolas uses the Immortal Sun to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica to harvest their sparks.
events.quote: Bolas used the Immortal Sun to trap many planeswalkers on Ravnica

events.summary: Chandra, Nissa, Saheeli, Lavinia and Lazav shut off the Immortal Sun at New Prahv after defeating Dovin Baan, using Azor's nine words.
events.quote: Chandra managed to shut it off with the spell

events.summary: The planeswalkers reactivate the Sun to prevent Bolas escaping; after Bolas is defeated it is made inactive but kept.
events.quote: they decided to reactivate the Immortal Sun to prevent Bolas from escaping

events.summary: New Prahv is severely damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion when Vraska directs Realmbreaker to attack the Azorius guild hall and jail.
events.quote: New Prahv was severely damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: Azor was in league with the Spirit Dragon
